nom: Jack Black Face Buff Energizing Scrub with Vitamin C & Mint

avis.texte: I use this product over and over. It works very well for me and highly recommended.

Started off great - nice and exfoliating with great scent- however after 7-10 uses the product kept clogging the tip and the exfoliating particles seemed to disappear like it had settled somewhere in the tube. Was disappointed in the end
I love this exfoliating cleanser! It cleans well and makes my face soft. It might be too abrasive for sensitive skin though.
I use this before every shave. I love the mint tingle and the exfoliating. Perfect for a pre shave wash.

I use this every other day before shaving with a double sided saftey razor. It's a total game changer. I get a much closer shave and leaves my skin feeling very soft and comfortable afterwards. I'm prone to getting ingrown hairs and razor bumps and have not had an issue since using this product.
Love this stuff my husband and I both use it. The smell is fabulous

Love to use this before shaving, skin feels refreshed and cleaned, I feel that helps to avoid after shaving irritation. Smells amazing, I', using just before shaving, as I'm afraid it can be too strong for a more frequent use, because of the beads.

avis.titre: Face wash for men who actually get dirty
avis.texte: Legitimately the best face wash for men ever! I am a mechanic by trade so needless to say I get sweaty/ dirty. This face wash has the right amount of grit to make me feel like I get my face clean without stripping off my skin. I would compare it to how using fast orange with pumice cleans your hands. Jack Black kills it with this face wash.
I have tried others, but whenever I return to the Jack Black brand the results are of a greater quality. The formula is like a paste with plenty of beads and it is not runny at all.
This face buff is my favorite Jack Black product. I use it every morning and love how fresh it makes my face feel. Great exfoliator and the mint really helps wake me up.

avis.titre: Great product and the scent was pleasant
avis.texte: Love the product but the scrub is too course, wish it were finer.
I like the feel of this product on my face, and neck, and use it before I shave for the day. It provides my skin with a glow and helps prepare my skin for the trauma of shaving.
It's great, feels smooth and refreshing after use. Great fragrance.

avis.titre: Amazing! Ditching my expensive scrub for this.
avis.texte: I bought this for my husband once before and I agree I think they changed the formula and the beads are bigger. I actually prefer the way it is now. I just used the new one and my face feels incredible. Husband said the same thing. I'm going to ditch my much more expensive Dr. Brandt and use this one moving forward.

I had a sample and was trying to get rid of all my samples. I used this one evening before bed. I was tired as it had been a long day. This scrub felt like it brought new life into me. I loved the mint tingling on my face and the scrub made my skin feel smooth and soft. I was hooked. I also use it from time to time on my body when I just want to feel super clean.
I like the scents and deep scrub I get while using this product. Leaves my face minty tingly and feeling refreshed.
Great Mild scrub with an incredible minty and energizing smell!

Bought the Christmas gift pack for my brother and he had recommended all products as we both have very similar skin. I love that it is simple and makes your skin feel refreshed. Has definitely improved my skin texture.
Borrowed and it only took one use for me to replace my Rodan & Fields exfoliating cleanser…great price point, effective grit, refreshing fragrance.
Works great on my husbands bald head. Smell great as well. I use it from time to time and love the coarseness of it.

I love Jack Black products. Been using this brand for years now and has never disappointed me yet. Face Buff Energizing Scrub is also one of those that I use regularly and I love it. My face feels clean and the minty feel after is refreshing. Keep up the good job JB!
Works very well. Great for a once a week exfoliation product. Leave skin feeling clean and smooth.

avis.titre: Why do companies change a good thing?
avis.texte: Jack Black 100% reformulated this. I used to love using my boyfriends scrub. It was labeled "peppermint" (notice how this one changed to "mint") and the beads were smaller. The new larger beads are way too harsh and unnecessary. Smell reduced too :(
Really missed it when it wasn't available anywhere for a month or so
Great after a shave. Clears pores, reduced ingrown facial hair and I love the cooling sensation that it provides for my face for a while after usage. Highly recommend.
I love this exfoliator. I, a cis woman use it every 2 days and it always leaves my face feeling clean and tingly. I look forward to using it!

avis.titre: Very Impressed with Face Buff product.
avis.texte: This product works real well for me, along with the Face Cleaner. I Would recommend it to anyone.
Outstanding! Long time user. I have been using this product since it first came on the market. I have always been extremely satisfied. Thank You.

avis.titre: Does miracles to your skin. Especially if you have a beard
avis.texte: I have a beard and I usually use CERAVE. it was leaving my beard dry and itchy i started using this. The first try you will feel a huge difference. I use it 2-3 times a week. Absolutely amazing!!!!!

My husband buys this energizing scrub wash for himself but i use it from time to time because it is an amazing facial scrubber! Smells amazing and leaves your skin feels fresh and "energized". It feels vigorous but not at the same time lol. Great product overall.

I'm new to JB. As a man I hated the idea of using facial products mainly because there wasn't a good mens brand. This was marketed well and I gave it a shot. BTW JB I have been a digital marketer for 9 years and you convinced me to buy. I'm glad I did. This stuff leaves my face feeling super clean and tingly. I also use the glycolic face wash and the body scrub. All great products.

I received this product from Influenster and Jack Black in exchange for my honest review. I was pleasantly surprised by this! It was the perfect level of exfoliation - not too rough or abrasive compared to others I've tried, the cleanser felt really nice on the skin and leaves your skin feeling smooth. The scent is also very mild and natural. I will keep using this and so will my boyfriend!

Best men's face scrub I've used. I use it before shaving so soften the bristles. I like the scent and how it feels when it exfoliates. Downside is the price. A little high-end, but worth the price as it gives a crisp-clean feeling. I will definitely buy it again. I also use the face moisturizer. I am not a fan of their after shave gel.

avis.titre: A little goes a long way
avis.texte: Been using this a couple times a week. Makes my skin feel and look better.
My 30 year old son loves this product. It was for his birthday along with your shampoo. Thank you for high quality products. He recommends your products.

Great scrub. Fresh and "tingly" feel with a great scent. The other part of it is that the scent does wear off pretty quickly so it doesn't interfere with any cologne you might be going to use. Glad I purchased this and will repurchase in the larger size.
Love the scrub, especially the mint aspect, however, the large beads are unnecessary and would be a better product if you removed them and just had the microabrasives.
The best face wash around. This face wash gives you a deep cleaning and the mint leaves your face feeling clean and polished.
This is an amazing product that's well worth the price. My face has never looked better. While its not the cheapest product you definitely get what you pay for and I say its worth the splurge.
Wonderful stuff. I like to use it when I shower after working out. It's so refreshing

avis.titre: Never thought I needed a pre shave til I got this stuff!
avis.texte: Love this stuff before a good shave. Will continue buying it!

avis.titre: Face Buff Great.  Daily Face Cleanser not good.
avis.texte: This is very good. However the Daily Facial Soap has an unusual odor. I called to ask about problem. They sent a replacement but that also does not have the normal scent. I'll continue to use the Face Buff but will no longer use the Facial Cleaner. The current aroma is not good.

Face Buff is by far my favorite Jack Black product that I use. Peppermint is one of my favorite scents which is another reason why I like it so much. It feels great on my skin and does a great job of helping getting rid of in-grown hairs.

avis.titre: Don't take it from me; try it yourself!
avis.texte: LOVE it! Face feels cleaner, oil free, and the cool, minty afterglow is wonderful.
Love the way it makes my face feel both during and after the scrub!
All these products are great. A great pick me up in the shower.
Look forward each morning to washing my face with the Face Buff. So invigorating. Makes your face feel extra clean.
I've been using it and other Jack Black products for years. All good!

I've been using this product for a few years now. Works great before a shave. Caution!!: This is a scrub not a daily face wash. You don't want to overuse this. I use it every other day. Leaves my face feeling refreshed and renewed.

avis.titre: Not like the old formula, micro beads are coarse
avis.texte: Micro-beads are coarse and just hurts your skin rather than gently peeling off the dead skin. After I was my face with it, I feel like my face is not cleansed and there is still some oil residue. Not like the old formula at all. Definitely it's not worth the price
Yes, i've tried a bunch of face scrubbs. I don't use daily but works well.
Has an invigorating aroma, removes dead skin cells and provides for a smoother shave. Highly recommend it.
I alternate every other day between the Beard Wash and Face Buff when showering and it makes for soft skin without being dying. It smells great (like most JB things) and it doesn't take much.
I love this product! Use it twice a week and absolutely feel energized every time. It's great to have actual products designed for men in this niche of skincare.
I use this on my head as I am bald, this stuff is great! Getting the smoothest shaves I ever have lately as I use this and the cream... good stuff!
Must take care in how much of this item is used when washing face. Other wise it is skin tightening after use.

Use this product twice a week for exfoliating the face and it is invigorating and great feeling and smelling! Really works! I even look forward to using it each time as it really wakes me up. Highly recommended.

avis.titre: Not as good as it was. Sharp granules.
avis.texte: I have use this for quite a while. I opened up a new large tube and the quality of the scrub is not nearly as good as it was. The previous one had smaller granules and had peppermint and bamboo. It was great. This one says menthol and vitamin C on the front and it feels cheap with sharp larger granules. So disappointing. When I looked at all the ingredients- two that I have and one online, they are all different. What gives??

I've bought this product several times. It does a good job on making my face feel clean. It gets rid of any oil that is on my face and keeps it that way for the rest of the day. It helps to soften the skin and I use the skin serum and daily facial lotion afterwards. It's a great product if you want to have a clean feeling to your face throughout the day. Even after going to the gym. My skin still feels clean. It's a good product to buy.
This face scrub is amazing! It smells great and does a great job of cleansing and removing dirt and dead skin cells. I feel refreshed after using it!
Really energizing scrub. The mint really clears off oils. Great product!!
Love it! Bought it for my hubby! But I sneak it for myself! Love the light minty tingle!
Quality product which you expect when talking about Jack Black items. Beats it's competition hands down.

Simply great. The smell is perfect, the abrasion is not too rough, but plenty to take off the dead skin. I absolutely love it. My wife also uses it when I'm not looking. You know its good if she uses it! This product is awesome!

I love this product. It has made such a difference to my face, especially my neck. It makes shaving my face so much more effective. It cleans my face so well that it just makes the stubble stand up. It is also such an invigorating feeling after using it. Thank you so much, my face has never looked this good.
Noticed a difference after using it for a week. Now I look forward to using it 3 times a week.
Amazing product. Super refreshing, in fact, my wife is now using this scrub too!
JB Scrub is the best I have ever used. Feels good and is energizing a good morning wake up.
One of the better face scrubs I've used. Just enough of a rough texture without feeling like sandpaper on your face. Great scent helps to wake you up.
When will it change again? Odd new scent, kinda 'dove' like. No longer energizing. It's been going down hill since the change but this bottle has got me looking for something new. Sad face.
This is the best face scrub that I have used so far! Leaves skin feeling very fresh.
Had been a go to product of mine for years. I absolutely love it.

This scrub is excellent. It effectively cleans the skin and also gives a refreshing jolt after using. I would recommend apply the Jack Black Moisturizer with the skin screen after cleansing, it did leave leave it a bit dry. But overall, I enjoy scrub greatly
A staple in my husband's skin care regimen. He uses it 1-2 times a week before cleansing, and combined with his Jack Black moisturizer, his skin is smoother and healthier than it's ever been.
I use in the morning while showering. Very refreshing and effective, my skin feels clean and smooth Just the right amount of scrubbing action.
It was reformulated a while ago and it's not nearly as good as it used to be. The scrubbing grains are too large.
Clean, refreshing. Just a little goes a long way. Love this stuff!
Used before shave it preps my beard for a closer shave and exfoliates my skin so it looks great, and leaves me feeling clean and refreshed

Last year I gave this 5 stars but, this year it's been very disappointing. Consistently, for the past several purchases, the bamboo powder (tiny exfoliation granules) has been more akin to bamboo grains. The granules were big to the point that instead of being an gentle abrasive, it was cutting my skin and causing bumps from irritation. As I said before, this used to be amazing product but after so many let downs from purchases, I've completely lost faith in the product and am now searching for another exfoliant.

avis.titre: Powerful Clean you can see and feel
avis.texte: This stuff is the real deal. It has a gritty feel that really digs deep into your pores and leaves you sparkling when you are done. Totally agree with the bottle that 2-3 times a week is enough, as frankly this leaves you almost too clean.....to the point that your skin needs a break for a day or two after.

avis.titre: Refreshing Feeling with Every Facial Cleaning!
avis.texte: Great product! I have been looking for a good facial scrub to cleanse my pores and get a good cleansing in the shower. I like the Jack Black Facial Buff because of the cool mint scent and gentle abrasiveness to get the deep clean I'm looking for. After each wash, my face feels very refreshed!
I love my facial scrub. I have sensitive skin and this product works great for me.
What an awesome face scrub. Smells great and feels incredible.
I posted a review in regards to the "new Jack Black" and how it wasn't the same. I would like to retract my previous comment. This product is this same. Great as ever!

avis.titre: We buy this over and over!
avis.texte: Wonderful product!! Had to try many others before finding this one.
It's a great morning or afternoon face wash. Refresh's your face and easily rinses.
Great product! Makes me feel like my skin is truly clean and fresh.

It has a nice. mild scent. Just like all Jack Black products. The beads that it has aren't very rough. So it cleans your skin comfortably. It's a cream type wash, not a gel. So it moisturizes your skin while it cleanses it. I've bought this face wash before. It makes my skin feel nice and clean after I use it.

Absolutely love this scrub. I use it 3 to 4 times a week to keep the acne at bay. I've had problem skin my entire life and now that I've switched over to Jack Black products it's finally under control. My wife loves it too! She asked me to get her one for when she's on the road.

I really like this product. It prepares my face for a close shave. I only use it every other day as directed and it leaves my face very smooth. I think it makes a noticeable difference. I highly recommend this.
Great product! Refreshing smell and feel. I use it 3 times per week to help keep my face clear of blemishes.
Great face scrub. Not too abrasive and leaves face feeling fresh and exfoliated. The peppermint smell and feeling is very refreshing.
I always use a scrub before I shave. This one left my skin quite irritated. My guess is the strong fragrance.

I had never used anything like this until my daughter gave me a tube. I don't know about the exfoliating part of this scrub BUT when I use it just before shaving I get the closest shave I have ever had. I am using an electric razor just think how close it would be with a blade.
I use it three times per week before shaving. It gives a great deep cleaning and smells terrific.

I absolutely love this face wash. The scent is pleasant and the exfoliating substance is just right(not too much grittiness and not too wimpy). I like to use this before shaving but am tempted to use it more often!
Used a sample of this before shaving. I've used many different brands of exfoliants andthis by far is simply the best. Need to order a full size bottle. made shaving that much less of a chore.

I miss the old formula. The grains are not as fine (almost too coarse) and I don't find my skin feels as refreshed. The smell also isn't as strong. Still a solid product but not the knockout the it used to be.

avis.titre: Jack Black Face Buff Energizing Scrub with Vitamin C & Mint
avis.texte: I have been looking for a solution to folliculitis, facial hair infection for over five years. Jack Black face buff scrub seems to be helping. I does take some time to change facial complexion, about 8 weeks, but I now enjoy it every morning in the shower. Highly recommend giving it a try. It took me a couple of tubes and daily use to notice a difference. Be patient, this is a good product.
I use this 3 days a week (Mon, Wed, & Fri) and I literally look forward to those days because of this scrub. The scent is amazing and my skin feels extremely soft after rinsing.
Smells great and feels refreshing. One of my favorite products for face. I highly recommend it- only a small amount is needed so you get a lot of use for price.

avis.titre: Formula closer to original but still disappointing
avis.texte: I'm happy the buffing agent is coarse again similar to the original formula. The scent is not as strong or rich as the original formula. This is disappointing.
I use it for regular exfoliating only. It works like a champ, especially on those annoying black and/or white-heads. Works wonders on and around the nose area, despite my combination skin.
Works as advertised! I get a closer shave with less irritation after using this scrub. Looking forward to ordering Jack Black shaving cream next!
My husband never requests a skin care product as a gift. This stuff he does. This along with the shave cream and moisturizer. He says it makes shaving easier.
It took me a while to figure out where this fit in my routine along my other JB products. But now that I have that figured I love it and my face feels much better because of it.
Smells nice, works great. I don't mind the bamboo particles. has a nice cooling sensation. I use this 3 times a week and the regular face wash the rest of the days.

I've read tons of comments about this product and it not being the same. I purchased this, knowing I had some hidden somewhere and BAM! The original/old face scrub has Vitamin C and Menthol!! Once the "new" Jack Black arrives, I will be returning it.
Leaves my face very fresh, cool and tingly. Doesn't dry out my face and definitely cleans my face good. Wish it came in a bigger bottle!
Many Jack Black products I love but have some major complaint about (packaging, size, cost). Not this one. Love it. Good grit, smells awesome, leaves my face feeling invigorated.
Love it. First found you at the 4 Seasons Spa in Jackson Hole. Probably 7 or 8 years ago. See you everywhere now. Congratulation. Have several friends using you as well. Keep up the good work.

Just like several other reviewers have pointed out, the reformulation is really disappointing. Waterered down and signifigantly less-scrubby/abrasive. There was a point in time where I considered this, without question, the best exfoliating scrub on the market - but not anymore. This is not the same product it used to be. Really disappointed!
